message:
Well, it seems like storm season is upon us again. Just last week, I was caught in a downpour while trying to figure out how to charge my phone in the backseat of my car. You’d think I’d learned my lesson about preparing for the unexpected by now! 

I came across a helpful resource from the Red Cross that covers everything from storm safety to having a plan when the power goes out. It’s a reminder that while we can’t control the weather, we can at least be ready for it. 

Do you have any tips for staying prepared when the skies turn gray? ☁️
